page.overview:
What is Any Time at All?

Any Time At All is a song by The Beatles, credited to Lennon/McCartney. It was mainly composed by John Lennon, with an instrumental middle eight by Paul McCartney. It first appeared on the Beatles' A Hard Day's Night album.
